storyBody.heading: A Running Clock Got Too Close to Its Edge
paragraphs: The incident began with a long-running system state. In the absence of a reset, small conversion effects in time handling accumulated while the battery remained online.
That accumulation became part of the target-tracking chain rather than a background metric, because timing drives prediction behavior.

paragraphs: On 25 February 1991, an incoming threat event led to the standard detection-and-engagement sequence at Dhahran.
Operational logs from this phase are central to the record because they show normal defensive posture before the timing mismatch translated into visible failure.

storyBody.heading: What the Track Log Showed Before the Strike

The timeline stayed verifiable through event markers: prolonged uptime, conversion precision limits, target estimate drift, and impact outcome.

storyBody.heading: Action: The Miss That Made Precision Feel Mythic
paragraphs: After impact, investigation teams separated mechanical condition from software timing behavior.

storyBody.heading: Aftermath: Recommendations and Limited Fixes
